clusters.name: Hot flat colour, heavy type
why: Each deck pairs one saturated colour (yellow, lime, red or orange-red; the hue changes per deck) with near-black and cream or white, in flat blocks with no gradients.
Headlines are the biggest thing on the slide, set very heavy and tight, with small plain labels around them and black-and-white photography.
clusters.confidence: medium. The structure is shared, the hue is not (four different hot colours), and one image (the lime mock-up scene) is borderline with the warm editorial group.
clusters.summary: Loud and flat. One hot colour per deck on near-black and cream, with a very heavy headline that is the biggest thing on the slide, often sitting on a solid colour bar. Small mono or plain labels, black-and-white photos, arrows in outlined pills, tape banners. No gradients and not much decoration beyond bars and pills. Would you say yes to that?

palette.text: Per deck the hot colour is yellow #FBCA06, lime #DBF920, orange-red #D73C1B / #DD4E2D or crimson #BF092F (see the per-image swatches). Around it: near-black about #141311 to #0E0E0E and cream or white about #FDFDF7. Merged palette and shares are in the table.

Text against its own slide background: median 13.5:1, worst 3.7:1 across the 58 slides cut. Hot colour on black: yellow 12.2:1, lime 15.9:1, orange-red 4.1 to 4.7:1, crimson 3.0:1. Hot colour on white: yellow 1.5:1, lime 1.2:1, orange-red 4.0 to 4.6:1, crimson 6.4:1. So yellow and lime only work as text on black; red and orange only barely pass 4.5:1 and only on the right side.
Role: hot colour = highlight bars, big numerals and one or two key words; near-black = text and alternate slide backgrounds; cream = alternate slide backgrounds.

type.text: Weight: extra-bold or black. Case: uppercase in the yellow, lime and orange-red decks; lower case in the crimson deck; sentence case with mono-italic phrases in one orange deck. Tight line spacing, headline lines often touch.

Alignment on the 24 plain-background slides that could be measured: 9 left, 7 centred, 6 mixed (2 had too few lines to tell). Tallest ink band over the smallest, median 11.6 (band heights, not font sizes: a multi-line headline is one band, so this overstates the font-size ratio). Tallest band about 38% of slide height.
Rough sizes: headline about 10 to 12 times the label size, body about 2 times the label size. Labels are small, often uppercase or monospace with // marks.

Nearest bundled fonts: Schibsted Grotesk 800 for the heavy head (it is wider and softer than the condensed or extended faces used in the references); Instrument Sans 500 for body. No bundled monospace, no condensed, no extended face.

cover.text: Huge headline filling the upper two thirds, left aligned, one line or phrase on a hot-colour bar; a photo cut-out or crop lower right; small mono label and handle strip along the top and bottom edge.

content.text: Heading top, one short paragraph in small type, a boxed black-and-white photo or laptop mock-up in the lower half; or a full-colour slide with just the heading and a button.

stat.text: Giant numeral (84%, 45+, 4 24 33 countdown) taking half the slide, in the hot colour or white, with one short label line and an outlined arrow pill.

quote.text: Dark slide, centred quote in uppercase mono, key phrase in the hot colour, a closing-quote mark, a round avatar above and five stars and a name below.

closing.text: Heading on a hot bar, a full-width black button bar reading like a call to action with a small arrow, a photo strip.

grid.text: Margins on plain-background slides: about 6.9% left and right, 6.5% top and 6.1% bottom (median of 24). Empty space: median 78% of the slide (range 29% to 91%).

graphics.text: Solid highlight bars behind heading lines; black label tags; diagonal tape banners with repeated text; outlined pills with an arrow; a starburst sticker; oval photo masks; halftone black-and-white portraits; big numerals; thin frame lines; asterisk and plus marks; one brush squiggle; hard offset shadows on mock-up cards.

rhythm.text: Colour alternates hot, black, cream from slide to slide. Cover and stat slides have the largest type; middle slides pair a smaller heading with a small body and a photo; the last slide is a bar-style call to action.

missingTools: Heavy condensed and extended display fonts (none bundled), and a monospace
Black-and-white and halftone treatment of photos; image masks beyond rectangle, rounded and oval
Tape banner (a rotated strip of repeated text that runs off the slide)
Different fonts or italics for single words inside one headline
Per-line solid bars that hug each line of a multi-line heading (our box highlight does this for single words only)
Hard offset shadows under cards; photographs of laptops and phones (mock-up frames)
Cutouts of people (blocked, see Step 4)

clusters.name: Warm editorial collage
why: Conversational, lower-case or sentence-case headlines mixing a very heavy grotesk with a serif italic word, on warm cream, butter yellow or dark photo backgrounds.
Photos sit under the type, and the surface feels hand-made: highlight bars behind phrases, stickers, tape, paper and halftone cut-outs.
clusters.confidence: low to medium. Only three images, and they differ: one is butter yellow and graphic, one is cream and brick red and calm, one is dark and photo-led with handwriting.
clusters.summary: Warm, human and a bit messy on purpose. Lower-case or sentence-case headlines in a very heavy sans with one serif-italic word, over photos or on cream and butter yellow. Highlight bars behind phrases, stickers, tape, halftone cut-outs, a little handwriting. Calmer than the first group and more about photos. Would you say yes to that?

palette.text: Butter yellow #EAE26D with near-black #181817 and cream #ECEAD7 (one deck); cream #F5EEE4 with near-black #0B0808 and brick red #7B2512 (one deck); dark #1B1A14 film-photo palette with cream #E1DCCF and a lime that the pixel count only partly caught (one deck). Dark backgrounds on 64% of the 36 slides.
Text against its own slide background: median 11.8:1, worst 3.5:1. Butter yellow on black 14.2:1, on white 1.3:1. Brick red on cream is about 9.8:1 against white, so it is safe as text.
Role: butter yellow or brick red is the highlight; cream is the paper; near-black is both text and the photo-heavy slides.

type.text: Weight: very heavy for the main voice, light or regular serif italic for the accent word, handwriting in one deck. Case: mostly lower case or sentence case, some condensed uppercase. Leading very tight, letters tight.
Alignment on the 6 measurable flat slides: 4 left, 1 centred, 1 mixed. 26 of 36 slides are photo-led, so most could not be measured for margins or bands.
Rough sizes: headline 8 to 10 times the label; labels are tiny uppercase handles and strapline text near the bottom edge.
Nearest bundled font: Schibsted Grotesk 800 for the heavy voice. No bundled serif italic, condensed face or handwriting.

cover.text: Huge lower-case headline filling most of the slide, one phrase underlined or circled by hand, small strap line and an arrow in the bottom corners.

content.text: Full-bleed photo with the headline set over it in white, cream or lime, a small block of tiny text in a corner; or a photo cut-out with words scattered around it.

quote.text: Centred statement in two voices (heavy plus serif italic) on a pale soft-gradient or paper background with small bulleted words in the corners.

closing.text: Heading over a photo with a thin arrow and the brand strip along the bottom edge.

grid.text: Margins on the 10 flat slides: about 5% left, 7% right, 5% top, 9% bottom (medians). Empty space median 68%.

graphics.text: Highlight bars behind words and phrases; underline and hand-drawn circle; halftone cut-outs; paper notes, torn labels, stamps and tape; dotted bullets; thin rules; one flower-shaped photo crop; a cut-out object that the text wraps around.

rhythm.text: Photo-led and flat type slides alternate; warm paper colour for the quiet slides; the strap line and handle are the same on every slide.

missingTools: Serif italic, condensed and handwriting fonts (none bundled)
Photo text-over-image layouts need photos: only possible with real pictures supplied by the user
Halftone, grain and paper textures; torn-paper and tape stickers
Hand-drawn circles and underlines that look hand drawn (ours are tidy paths)
Different fonts or italics for single words inside one headline
Irregular photo masks (flower, blob); text wrapping around a cut-out (cutouts blocked)

clusters.name: Quiet dark minimal
why: Near-black or off-white (sage, cream) backgrounds with a light regular sans and almost no colour at all.
Huge amounts of empty space, tiny body text, thin outlined pills, monochrome photography.
clusters.confidence: medium. Two images, both clearly the same restrained mood, but one is dark and one is pale sage and white.
clusters.summary: Quiet and expensive-feeling. Near-black or pale sage and white, one light sans heading, tiny body text, a lot of empty space, thin outlined buttons, monochrome photos. A serif-italic phrase is the only flourish. Nothing is loud. Would you say yes to that?

palette.text: Near-black #1C1C1C (59% of one sheet) with cream #E3DAC9 / #F5ECE3; or sage #E1E5E2 with white #F8F8F8 and black #181818. There is no saturated colour (no hot colour was found in either image).
Text against its own slide background: median 11.2:1, worst 2.8:1 (grey secondary text on dark). Dark backgrounds on half of the 18 slides.
Role: the secondary text is a mid grey on purpose, which is why the worst contrast is low; it would fail our 4.5:1 rule.

type.text: Weight: light or regular for the heading, regular for tiny body; one serif-italic phrase for emphasis. Case: sentence case, some small uppercase labels. Leading normal to tight.
Alignment on the 12 measurable slides: 0 left, 3 centred, 9 mixed (the heading is left and small text blocks sit at the bottom or in columns). Tallest ink band is about 15% of slide height.
Rough sizes: heading about 3 to 4 times the body text; body text is tiny (on our 1080 px slide it would be about 20 px, below our 32 px minimum).
Nearest bundled font: Instrument Sans 400 or 500 (a good match). No bundled serif italic.

cover.text: Heading top-left in sentence case over dark photography or plain colour, a thin outlined button bottom centre, a small mark and a round arrow button in the top corners.

content.text: Heading at the top, three short columns of tiny text near the bottom with a strip of three photos under them, or a single block of tiny text and a thin rule at the foot.

stat.text: A huge faded numeral (01) cropped by the slide edge behind a left-aligned heading.

closing.text: A big asterisk or logo mark, one short sentence with a serif-italic phrase and a small outlined button.

grid.text: Margins on flat slides: about 6.9% left, 7.5% right, 9% top and bottom. Empty space median 89% (range 77% to 94%).

graphics.text: Thin outlined pills and round arrow buttons; a thin horizontal rule; a large asterisk; one big faded numeral; photo strips of three; soft grey gradient bands.

rhythm.text: Almost no change in tone slide to slide: dark and light slides alternate, the layout stays the same and only the amount of text changes.

missingTools: Serif italic font (none bundled)
Soft grey gradient bands and blurred shading (our gradients are straight linear only)
Small outlined pill button and round arrow button (cheap to add)
Strip of three photos; monochrome photo treatment
A text-size floor conflict: the tiny body text in these references is below our 32 px rule

clusters.name: 3D object with a neon accent
why: Black and white slides alternate; the headline's last line or key words are in one neon accent (lime, mint or violet).
Almost every slide has one glossy 3D object or a UI-card illustration, a small button, and tidy symmetrical placement.
clusters.confidence: medium to high. Four images share structure strongly; the neon hue differs per deck and one deck is square, one is 4:5.
clusters.summary: Polished tech and SaaS look. Black and white slides alternate. The headline is bold and its last line or a few words are in one neon colour (lime, mint or violet). Each slide has one glossy 3D object or a UI card, a small button and a page number. Tidy and symmetrical. Would you say yes to that?

palette.text: Near-black about #111614 / #101917 / #04020B (40% to 49% of the sheets) and near-white #F1EEE7 / #EBECEC / #E8E5EB; accent mint #45C9A0, lime #AFC62B or violet #593F95 / #775CB8 depending on the deck. Small accents below about 1% of the slide area are often missed by the pixel count, so the violet of one deck was found only on some slides.

Text against its own slide background: median 12.9:1, worst 4.5:1. Mint #45C9A0 on black 9.1:1 but only 2.1:1 on white; violet #593F95 on white 8.1:1 but 2.3:1 on black (the lighter violet #775CB8 is 3.6:1 on black), so violet text on black would fail; the lime-green samples (#7E8A48 and #92A057, taken from the 3D objects) are 5.0 to 6.6:1 on black. The bright lime of the headline words covers too little area to be picked up by the pixel count.
Role: accent for emphasised words, buttons and glow; near-black and near-white for alternating slides.

type.text: Weight: bold to extra-bold grotesk, tight leading. Case: uppercase condensed in the lime deck, sentence case or title case in the others. Left aligned (or centred in one deck). Body in regular weight.
Alignment on 16 measurable slides: 9 left, 1 centred, 5 mixed. Tallest ink band about 48% of slide height (usually the object). Margins about 6.9% left, 5.6% right, 6.7% top, 4.5% bottom.
Rough sizes: headline 3 to 4 times the body; labels about half the body size.
Nearest bundled fonts: Schibsted Grotesk 700 or 800 for the heading, Instrument Sans 400 for body (a good match for the sentence-case decks).

cover.text: Heading top-left (about a third of the slide height), two or three short lines of body under it, the 3D object filling the lower half and bleeding off the edge, a round or pill button bottom-left.

content.text: Same layout with a UI card, laptop or phone illustration instead of the object; icon rows (four small icons with captions) in a band along the bottom.

stat.text: Three cards in a row, each with a small icon, a big number and a one-line caption.

checklist.text: Heading, then a list of rows each with a small cross or tick icon, beside a device illustration.

closing.text: Heading, one short line and a bright pill button, a glowing curved line down one side; a rocket or similar object.

grid.text: Empty space median 82% on the 16 flat slides (range 60% to 89%).

graphics.text: Glossy 3D objects and glass shapes; UI cards and callout cards (white and mint, slightly rotated); small square or round markers; a glowing curved line; hand-drawn loop arrows; icon rows with captions; page number bottom right; a brand mark top-left.

rhythm.text: Strict alternation of black and white slides with the same layout grid; the cover has the biggest object, the last slide a pill button and a glow.

missingTools: 3D rendered objects and glass shapes. We cannot make these (no AI image generation, no 3D renderer); a flat shape would be a worse substitute and is not faked
Glow and soft shadow effects (no blur on shapes, only on photos)
UI card illustrations: simple ones (a card with lines and a chart) are possible but not built yet
Callout cards that are slightly rotated (rotation is supported for shapes; text rotation is not)
Hand-drawn loop arrows (curved path arrows are possible, not built yet)
Icon row and page-number components (cheap to add); more icons (globe, heart, comment, send, shield)

unplaced.reason: Blurred gradient glass with light type is its own look. It sits between the quiet dark minimal group (thin light type, lots of space) and the 3D-object group (soft glowing shapes), and I did not want to force it into either.
